exact.✗ 再想想，請回到構造與閾值機制。 · Review the mechanism: ✗ Think again: go back to the structure and the threshold mechanism.

f27994755d77.zh:
2.1 生物神經元
Soma · Dendrites · Synapse
f27994755d77.en:
2.1 The Biological Neuron
Soma · Dendrites · Synapse

9332f6d39365.zh: 從一顆活的神經細胞，走向人工神經元 From a living neuron to an artificial abstraction.
9332f6d39365.en: From a living nerve cell to the artificial neuron

d3f1dd0e3e3f.zh: 構造 Structure 閾值 Threshold 抽象 Abstraction

f0b82c49f3e9.zh:
按 ← → 或空白鍵開始
Use arrow keys or Space to navigate.
f0b82c49f3e9.en: Press ← → or the Space bar to begin

aead0ee3389f.zh:
人工神經元，
到底在模仿什麼？What is the artificial neuron actually inspired by?
aead0ee3389f.en:
The artificial neuron:
what is it actually imitating?

311004d1807e.zh: 答案不是「一顆迷你大腦」，而是一套從生物機制抽取出的計算直覺。 It is a computational intuition loosely inspired by biology.
311004d1807e.en: The answer is not “a miniature brain” but a computational intuition extracted from a biological mechanism.

2e3946d28dba.zh: 先看原型 · Start with the prototype

75db1d25c357.zh: 先理解 Soma、Dendrites 與 Synapse 各自做什麼，才看得懂人工版本保留了哪一段因果。 Understand the parts before reading the abstraction.
75db1d25c357.en: Only once you understand what the soma, the dendrites and the synapse each do can you see which part of the causal chain the artificial version keeps.

99d3f45906fe.zh: 從一顆活的神經細胞講起 Start with a Living Neuron
99d3f45906fe.en: Start with a Living Nerve Cell

0a58c4857c50.zh: 人工神經網路由人工神經元組成；這個名字不是隨便取的，而是鬆散地受到生物神經元啟發。 Artificial neurons are loosely inspired by biological neurons.
0a58c4857c50.en: Artificial neural networks are made of artificial neurons; the name was not picked at random, but comes from being loosely inspired by biological neurons.

234af4ddaf79.zh: Fig. 1 · 生物神經元主要構造
234af4ddaf79.en: Fig. 1 · Main structures of a biological neuron

4f6daa1e3667.zh: 接收 → 整合 → 傳導 → 化學傳遞 · Receive, integrate, transmit, pass on.

ba6dfca84599.zh: 這張圖看什麼？ · Reading the Figure

ad8791a0a9fd.zh: Dendrites 把鄰居的電化學訊號帶進來，Soma 負責整合，Axon 再把結果往下游傳。 Dendrites receive; the soma integrates; the axon carries the result.
ad8791a0a9fd.en: The dendrites bring in electrochemical signals from neighboring neurons, the soma integrates them, and the axon then passes the result downstream.

8917373ff4f7.zh: 人工神經元不是完整複製細胞，而是抓住「多路輸入被整合，再做決策」這條因果線。 The model keeps a causal pattern, not the whole cell.
8917373ff4f7.en: The artificial neuron is not a complete copy of the cell; it captures one causal line: “multiple inputs are integrated, then a decision is made.”

6b6fbf340692.zh: 五個關鍵部件，各司其職 Five Parts, Five Roles
6b6fbf340692.en: Five Key Parts, Each with Its Own Job

6f89cb7a086f.zh: 神經元的本體，把收到的訊號整合起來；像一座城的市中心，訊息最後匯到這裡。 The soma integrates incoming signals.
6f89cb7a086f.en: The main body of the neuron, which integrates the signals it receives; like a city’s downtown, it is where all the messages finally converge.

61fb6c008ca6.zh: 位於 Soma 內部，存放遺傳物質並調控細胞活動，是細胞的指揮中心。 The nucleus stores genetic material and regulates activity.
61fb6c008ca6.en: Located inside the soma, it stores the genetic material and regulates the cell’s activity: it is the cell’s command center.

200d1f2ee371.zh: 像樹枝一樣延伸，接收其他神經元的訊號，並把它們往 Soma 方向傳送。 Dendrites receive and route signals inward.
200d1f2ee371.en: They extend like tree branches, receive signals from other neurons, and carry them toward the soma.

8371d7c1aa6f.zh: 位於一顆神經元的軸突末端與另一顆神經元樹突之間，負責化學傳遞。 A synapse passes a chemical message across a tiny gap.
8371d7c1aa6f.en: Located between the axon terminal of one neuron and a dendrite of another neuron, it handles chemical transmission.

155e3f925f3e.zh: 還有一條傳導線 · The Transmission Path
155e3f925f3e.en: One More Conduction Line: the Transmission Path

52de2e5e8778.zh: Axon（軸突）把 Soma 的結果傳向下一個神經元；它把「整合後的結果」送出，而不是重新收集輸入。 The axon carries the integrated result onward.
52de2e5e8778.en: The axon carries the soma’s result on to the next neuron; it sends out the “integrated result” rather than collecting the inputs all over again.

80e27e244156.zh: 閾值觸發：發火，或不發火 Threshold Triggering — Fire or Stay Silent
80e27e244156.en: Threshold Triggering: Fire, or Don’t Fire

ef7c9dada86b.zh: 構造只是舞臺；真正關鍵是 Soma 如何把多路訊號累積，再和門檻比較。 The mechanism is accumulation followed by a threshold decision.
ef7c9dada86b.en: The structure is only the stage; what really matters is how the soma accumulates multiple signals and then compares the total with a threshold.

6bbe0ff72e94.zh: 樹突與突觸收到鄰居們的電化學訊號，帶進 Soma。 Inputs arrive through dendrites and synapses.
6bbe0ff72e94.en: The dendrites and synapses receive electrochemical signals from the neighboring neurons and bring them into the soma.

45dda357c469.zh: 細胞體把訊號整合成一個總量，準備和 threshold 比較。 The soma accumulates one total signal.
45dda357c469.en: The cell body integrates the signals into one total, ready to be compared with the threshold.

6a95046f0f42.zh: 超過門檻就產生 action potential；沒有超過，就維持沉默。 Cross the threshold and fire; otherwise stay silent.
6a95046f0f42.en: Above the threshold, an action potential is produced; if not, the neuron stays silent.

49fdb73d3e23.zh: 最小因果鏈 · Minimal Causal Chain

51224c5f873d.zh: $$\text{累積訊號} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{比較門檻 } \theta \;\longrightarrow\; \text{發火或靜默}$$
51224c5f873d.en: $$\text{accumulated signal} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{compare with threshold } \theta \;\longrightarrow\; \text{fire or stay silent}$$

26330ed6fd86.zh: 這個「超過就開、沒超過就關」的機制，正是人工神經元最核心的生物靈感。 A biological threshold becomes a computational switch.
26330ed6fd86.en: This “above it, switch on; below it, switch off” mechanism is exactly the core biological inspiration behind the artificial neuron.

4875a2b9b97d.zh: 把門檻拉動：同一組訊號，結果會變嗎？ Interactive Threshold — Same Inputs, Different Decision
4875a2b9b97d.en: Move the Threshold: Same Signals, Different Result?

3accae8cbf07.zh: 三路訊號的總和固定為 $1.6$；拖動門檻 $\theta$，觀察「發火／靜默」由真實比較結果決定。 The input sum is fixed at 1.6; move the threshold and recompute the decision.
3accae8cbf07.en: The sum of the three signals is fixed at $1.6$; drag the threshold $\theta$ and watch how “fire / silent” is decided by the actual comparison.

974c91ccab1a.zh: 累積總和固定，只有門檻在移動。 The sum stays fixed; only the threshold moves.
974c91ccab1a.en: The accumulated sum is fixed; only the threshold moves.

3548f2ad6c0e.zh: 不是訊號本身突然變了，而是比較標準變嚴格或變寬鬆；這就是閾值如何控制開關。 The threshold changes the standard, not the incoming signal.
3548f2ad6c0e.en: It is not that the signal itself suddenly changed; the standard of comparison just became stricter or looser. That is how a threshold controls the switch.

54120f6d710c.zh: 從生物到抽象：保留哪一條因果？ From Biology to Abstraction
54120f6d710c.en: From Biology to Abstraction: Which Causal Line Do We Keep?

db3af06a7a12.zh: 因果結構被保留 · Causal pattern preserved

0058f5bb9e04.zh: 不是複製細胞，而是抽取「累積 → 閾值 → 開關」· Abstract the mechanism.
0058f5bb9e04.en: Not copying the cell, but extracting “accumulate → threshold → switch”

fc172e2f3761.zh: 多路訊號變成多個加權輸入；累積總量變成加權和；發火或不發火變成 0 或 1。 Inputs, accumulation, and firing become a compact computation.
fc172e2f3761.en: Multiple signals become multiple weighted inputs; the accumulated total becomes a weighted sum; firing or not firing becomes 0 or 1.

e67e71a6bbb7.zh: 人工模型不是完整的生物模擬；它只保留對計算有用的閾值式決策直覺。 The abstraction is useful precisely because it is selective.
e67e71a6bbb7.en: The artificial model is not a complete biological simulation; it keeps only the threshold-style decision intuition that is useful for computation.

dcf95dfe885e.zh: 人工神經元的抽象 · Artificial Abstraction

2680fb686cda.zh: 生物上的「累積 + 閾值 + 開關」，在數學上變成「加權和 + 啟用函式」。 Accumulation and thresholding become weighted sum and activation.
2680fb686cda.en: The biological “accumulation + threshold + switch” becomes, in mathematics, “weighted sum + activation function.”

dfc3236316d4.zh: 一眼看懂：生物部件如何變成計算角色 Biological Parts Become Computational Roles
dfc3236316d4.en: At a Glance: How Biological Parts Become Computational Roles

c0621a8a1ffb.zh: 把名詞放回功能，不要只背一張「名詞連連看」。 Connect each biological part to the function it contributes.
c0621a8a1ffb.en: Put each term back into its function; don’t just memorize a “match the terms” worksheet.

58de27eaf92f.zh: Dendrites · 樹突：接收多路訊號

e2a61ed88c0d.zh: Synapse · 突觸：化學傳遞的接縫
e2a61ed88c0d.en: Synapse: the seam where chemical transmission happens

0794445fab81.zh: 輸入之間的連線與影響
0794445fab81.en: The connections between inputs and their influence

3fb0bd9b4365.zh: Threshold · 門檻：決定是否發火

8f25522f41ef.zh: 把輸出 $\hat y$ 傳給下一個單元
8f25522f41ef.en: Pass the output $\hat y$ on to the next unit

a1520a91f596.zh: 最短版本 · The Short Version

e1de2dd5a172.zh: 生物神經元先接收、再整合、最後決定是否發火；人工神經元把這條流程壓縮成可計算的函式。 Receive, integrate, decide — then transmit.
e1de2dd5a172.en: A biological neuron first receives, then integrates, and finally decides whether to fire; the artificial neuron compresses this process into a computable function.

e78a11006c25.zh: 歷史銜接：McCulloch–Pitts 模型的雛形 The McCulloch–Pitts Bridge
e78a11006c25.en: Historical Bridge: The Prototype of the McCulloch–Pitts Model

5b849fbd5dd2.en: Signals Are Not Independent of Each Other

898a4efdfd10.zh: 多個鄰居同時影響一顆神經元；Soma 必須把這些輸入整合起來。 Many neighbors contribute to one integrated state.
898a4efdfd10.en: Several neighbors influence one neuron at the same time; the soma has to integrate these inputs.

af6a21181c4d.en: Compress the Continuous Details into a Switch

c22a33994ef2.zh: 早期模型先抓住超過門檻就開、沒有超過就關的邏輯。 The early abstraction keeps the threshold logic.
c22a33994ef2.en: The early models first captured the logic “above the threshold, switch on; below it, switch off.”

e864efd83694.zh: 這條「累積 + 閾值 + 開關」的想法，成為 kp3 McCulloch–Pitts 模型的雛形。 It becomes a seed for the McCulloch–Pitts model.
e864efd83694.en: This idea of “accumulation + threshold + switch” became the prototype of the McCulloch–Pitts model in kp3.

88f7cf9f0b95.zh: 人工神經網路的故事不是突然從電腦裡冒出來；它先把生物機制轉成一個可重複計算的最小單元。 The history begins by turning a biological mechanism into a repeatable unit.
88f7cf9f0b95.en: The story of artificial neural networks did not suddenly pop out of a computer; it began by turning a biological mechanism into a minimal unit that can be computed over and over.

85384c9e39fe.zh: 把 Fig. 1 說給生圖模型聽 A Structured Prompt for Re-drawing Fig. 1
85384c9e39fe.en: Describing Fig. 1 to an Image-Generation Model

2afaf243c4d3.zh: 如果要用 AI 重繪示意圖，先把構造、流程與視覺限制說清楚。 A useful image prompt specifies anatomy, causal flow, and visual constraints.
2afaf243c4d3.en: If you want AI to redraw the diagram, first spell out the structure, the flow, and the visual constraints clearly.

4df1bf5db886.zh: 主體是一顆清楚、可標註的生物神經元，而不是抽象腦部照片。 Show one labeled neuron, not a brain photograph.
4df1bf5db886.en: The subject is one clear biological neuron that can be labeled, not an abstract photo of a brain.

9a97a880b0bf.zh: 箭頭必須讓觀眾看出訊號從哪裡來、在哪裡整合、如何往下游傳。 Make the signal path and decision point explicit.
9a97a880b0bf.en: The arrows must let viewers see where the signals come from, where they are integrated, and how they travel downstream.

1e3ccdd9682b.zh: 使用清晰的中英雙語標註，讓 Fig. 1 同時支援構造與機制教學。 Use readable bilingual labels for structure and mechanism.
1e3ccdd9682b.en: Use clear Chinese–English bilingual labels so that Fig. 1 supports teaching both the structure and the mechanism.

475c5ece7432.zh: 優先可讀性與因果方向，不要讓裝飾搶走教學訊息。 Prioritize legibility and causal clarity.
475c5ece7432.en: Put legibility and the causal direction first; don’t let decoration steal the teaching message.

84bdad9bdeeb.zh: 換你試試看：把機制說回來 Retrieval Practice — Explain the Mechanism
84bdad9bdeeb.en: Your Turn: Explain the Mechanism Back

ec7902aec517.zh: 點選答案，確認你抓住「構造 → 累積 → 閾值 → 抽象」的因果鏈。 Test the chain from anatomy to threshold abstraction.
ec7902aec517.en: Click an answer to check that you have grasped the causal chain “structure → accumulation → threshold → abstraction.”

900361833e2a.zh: Q1. 哪個部件主要接收其他神經元的訊號？Which part mainly receives incoming signals?
900361833e2a.en: Q1. Which part mainly receives signals from other neurons?

baad55147eab.zh: Axon：把結果送出去 Carries the result onward

2000b35678ec.zh: Q2. 訊號超過 threshold 時會怎樣？What happens above the threshold?
2000b35678ec.en: Q2. What happens when the signal exceeds the threshold?

849ad48716e2.zh: 產生 action potential，發火 An action potential fires
849ad48716e2.en: An action potential is produced: the neuron fires

16cd383984b4.zh: 立刻消失，保持沉默 The neuron stays silent
16cd383984b4.en: It vanishes immediately and stays silent

0866d948e327.zh: Q3. 生物「累積 + 閾值」在數學上對應什麼？What is the mathematical abstraction?
0866d948e327.en: Q3. What does the biological “accumulation + threshold” correspond to in mathematics?

d84491b34174.zh: 只保留細胞核的遺傳物質 Only the genetic material
d84491b34174.en: Keeping only the genetic material in the nucleus

76d72fc1dc66.zh: 加權和 + 啟用函式 Weighted sum plus activation

0063f11c690c.zh: 先問「訊號在哪裡被整合」，再問「門檻如何把連續總量變成開關」。 Locate integration first, then locate the threshold switch.
0063f11c690c.en: First ask “where are the signals integrated?”, then ask “how does the threshold turn a continuous total into a switch?”

2ff2ed2c5a5d.zh: 四句話帶走 2.1 Four Sentences to Take Away

be3e453dde8e.en: The Soma Integrates, the Dendrites Receive

3cd2a3fb6451.zh: 神經元的構造分工，讓訊號有清楚的進入與整合路徑。 Structure creates a path for receiving and integrating signals.
3cd2a3fb6451.en: The neuron’s division of labor among its structures gives signals a clear path in and a clear place to be integrated.

39344186422c.zh: 突觸是神經元之間的接縫
39344186422c.en: The Synapse Is the Seam Between Neurons

7339fd63583c.zh: 化學訊號跨過微小間隙，把一顆細胞的結果交給下一顆。 Synapses pass chemical messages across a tiny gap.
7339fd63583c.en: A chemical signal crosses a tiny gap, handing one cell’s result over to the next.

933f675c828c.en: Accumulate Past the Threshold, and It Fires

7c884106cdc2.zh: 超過 threshold 產生 action potential；沒超過就保持沉默。 Cross the threshold to fire; otherwise stay silent.
7c884106cdc2.en: Exceeding the threshold produces an action potential; otherwise the neuron stays silent.

3d1169162c5d.zh: 生物直覺成為數學積木
3d1169162c5d.en: Biological Intuition Becomes a Mathematical Building Block

26fe591aa4ea.zh: 「累積 + 閾值 + 開關」成為「加權和 + 啟用」，銜接 McCulloch–Pitts 模型雛形。 A biological switch becomes a mathematical building block.
26fe591aa4ea.en: “Accumulation + threshold + switch” becomes “weighted sum + activation,” leading into the prototype of the McCulloch–Pitts model.

3059adbf3f4f.zh: 本節主線 · The Main Line
3059adbf3f4f.en: The Main Line of This Section

1067336dda0f.zh: Soma／Dendrites／Synapse → 累積 → threshold → 發火／靜默 → 人工神經元 Anatomy becomes computation through thresholded integration.
1067336dda0f.en: Soma / Dendrites / Synapse → accumulation → threshold → fire / silent → artificial neuron
